title: Organic Livestock Farming's Global Rise Explained
reason: The video discusses the rise of organic livestock farming and its benefits, challenges, and growing popularity.

tasks.task: Explain the benefits of organic livestock farming.

subtasks.text: Note people's growing consciousness about what they consume and their desire for health and environmental benefits.
Describe how organic farming respects nature and results in healthier animals and nutrient-packed products.

tasks.task: Discuss the challenges of organic livestock farming.
